prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: 64x64 static recognition-seal fallback for the Chaos Redux Event 006 scripted GUI.
Primary request: Edit Image 1 into a richer painted version of the same hidden-state recognition seal. Preserve the exact centered circular silhouette, scale, placement, deep navy enamel face, and small ivory five-point star. Change only the flat finish: give the enamel restrained curved tonal shading and subtle surface texture, and replace the thin simple bronze perimeter with a layered, ornate bronze rim with beveled highlights and dark recesses, following the metal depth and painted shading in Image 2. Keep it as a subdued inactive seal with no cyan halo or glow.
Input images: Image 1, existing transparent hidden-state seal, edit target. Image 2, existing transparent strong-state seal, material and relief reference only; do not copy its bright star, cyan rim, or state intensity.
Style/medium: compact painterly embossed game icon with clean, stable edges.
Composition/framing: centered 1:1 seal with about 3 pixels of transparent corner margin on the final 64x64 canvas; preserve the target's center and silhouette.
Lighting/mood: soft warm highlights across bronze bevels with deep navy shadow, inactive and dignified.
Color palette: deep navy enamel, aged bronze, muted warm gold, ivory star, restrained dark outline.
Constraints: request genuine transparency and preserve transparent unused canvas; keep the whole seal visible. No text, lettering, flags, ribbons, banners, extra symbols, external border, background, or watermark.
Avoid: flat navy fill, a thin unshaded gold stroke, cyan glow, fake checkerboard, opaque canvas, matte, halo, clipped edge, blur, white sticker outline, or added symbols.
